subject: POC hands-on: aligning calendar for load & routing workshop (throughput targets + test harness)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on load & routing workshop

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to get the POC kickoff on the calendar and include a hands-on session where your team helps us validate our routing + caching patterns and run a throughput baseline. High level ask: a 3-hour slot for prompt review, routing checks, and a controlled load run (target ~10k tokens/sec across 8 clients).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 22: 09:00–12:00
- Wed Jun 23: 13:00–16:00
- Fri Jun 25: 08:00–11:00

We can provide 2 engineers (me + Emily Chen) and will bring the sample dataset and test harness. Please let us know what you need from Redwood ahead of time (expected runbook, run-of-show, attachment format).

Also — we need latency SLO guidance: 95th percentile target for interactive routing flows (we aim for <=250ms if possible).

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
SRE Lead, Acme Commerce
[Attachment: preliminary_traffic_matrix.csv (CSV, 18KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on load & routing workshop

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely run a 3-hour hands-on block and validate routing + caching behavior. A few quick notes and requests: 

1) Test harness: can you upload the harness to the Drive link you shared? if not, send a short README. We prefer k6-style harness or a simple Go harness that hits the callee endpoints.
2) Throughput: 10k tokens/sec across 8 clients is doable; we'll want a short dry-run first (15–30m) to verify batch sizes and KV cache warmup.
3) Latency: we'll aim for 95p under 300ms for routed interactive flows in the POC; we can refine based on model choice and quantization.

Proposed Redwood availability (PST):
- Tue Jun 22: 10:00–13:00 (flexible start)
- Wed Jun 23: 14:00–17:00
- Thu Jun 24: 09:00–12:00 (alternate)

I've attached a sample load profile and a short checklist for pre-run items. Marcus will own the runbook during the session and Laura will join for routing/playback and model pinning.

Thanks — I can take the 22nd if that works for you.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_load_profile.json (JSON, 12KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on load & routing workshop

Looping in for scheduling and ops readiness. Quick internal notes: 

- I'll reserve the lab pool and confirm GPU availability for the dry-run + full run. If we need the Dedicated pool we should lock it now (inventory is tight the week of Jun 21).
- Marcus: can you prepare the runbook (start time checklist, KV cache warmup commands, batch-size table) and share by EOD Tue? I put a stub in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-test-harness
- For latency SLOs: recommend documenting the 95p and 99p targets per prompt class; Samir noted 250ms which may be aggressive depending on model size and quantization. We'll propose 95p <= 300ms and 99p <= 600ms as a starting baseline.

Samir — if you prefer the 22nd, we can take it but would like to start at 10:00 PST to leave an hour after for logs and artifact collection. If the 22nd is tight, Wed 23rd at 14:00 also works.

Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook_template.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on load & routing workshop

Thanks — Wed Jun 23 at 14:00 PST works best for our team (Emily and I are available). We prefer the later start to allow our devs to finish sprint work in the morning. Can you confirm the dry-run cadence (we expect a 20m dry-run, then two 45m full runs with a 20m tuning window between)?

Also: we'll upload the harness and a README to the Drive link by EOD today and include the traffic matrix. If possible, please send the runbook PDF and the exact endpoints we'll be hitting (so my team can pre-configure the client).

Appreciate it — Samir
Samir Patel
SRE Lead, Acme Commerce

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on load & routing workshop

Perfect — Wed Jun 23, 14:00–17:00 PST is booked. Calendar invite: sent.

Run-of-show (summary):
- 14:00–14:20 — dry-run (connectivity, auth, small-scale traffic)
- 14:20–15:05 — full run A (45m)
- 15:05–15:25 — tuning & cache warmup
- 15:25–16:10 — full run B (45m)
- 16:10–16:50 — log collection, artifact snapshot, debrief

Artifacts attached/linked: runbook_v1.pdf (with endpoints), sample_load_profile.json, and instructions for the test harness (test_harness_instructions.md) — Drive link below. We'll also create a single-trace S3 bundle after the run and share.

Quick note on SLOs: we'll instrument 95p/99p and token throughput in the dashboard; expect our initial baseline numbers by EOD Thu. If we see infra constraints we'll fall back to a smaller model variant for the second run.

See you Wednesday — calendar invite shows conference bridge and joint Slack channel #acme-poc.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]
